title: SPARK: Self-Correcting Embodied Memory via Physical Re-Observation

title: RoboScope Kit: Unified Interfaces for Fast and Scalable Embodied-AI Evaluation
why: B-type evaluation harness/kit: unified Policy class + benchmark adapters preserve each suite's rules/scoring while concurrent simulator/Policy pools and observation-chunk optimizations speed closed-loop embodied-AI evaluation across six benchmark families.
mechanism: RoboScope Kit: wrap each model once as Policy class and each benchmark once as adapter around the benchmark's own evaluator (rules/scoring unchanged); schedule separate simulator-worker and Policy-replica pools sized from probes; shard deterministically; render only observations an action-chunk Policy reads.
